other_conditions: Applicant must be a pregnant woman
Applicant must be admitted in a government health facility
Sick newborns up to 30 days (or infants up to one year) must be treated at public health institutions
benefits_summary: Provides free and cashless delivery, including C‑section, drugs, diagnostics, diet, blood, transport and other services for pregnant women, and free treatment for sick newborns/infants at public health institutions.
